learning_outcomes.text: Knows the structure and operating principle of a 3-phase asynchronous motor and recognizes its label.
Knows the torque-speed characteristic of a 3-phase asynchronous motor. Defines slip.
Performs power flow analysis in 3-phase asynchronous motors.
Understands the motor and generator operation of a synchronous machine and defines the effect of excitation current.
Performs performance analysis of a synchronous generator under different load and excitation current conditions.
Performs performance analysis of a synchronous motor under different load and excitation current conditions.

syllabus_topics: Three-Phase Induction Machines (Equivalent circuit model, operation in motor-generator-braking modes, locked rotor and no-load tests, torque-speed characteristics, ratings and efficiency, starting methods, speed control)
Single-phase induction motors (equivalent circuit, steady-state operation, starting)

Synchronous Machines (operation in generator and motor mode, cylindrical and salient pole rotor types, equivalent circuit model, open and short circuit tests, excitation systems and voltage regulation, applications)
